notes.title: Devlog #1 - September 2025
notes.notes:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558627/59674643b0b5c7a8155e3638f71ab17654d27335.png"][/img]Good day, community!   

After lots of behind-the-scenes work, we’re excited to share our very first technical devlog, along with a look at the progress we’ve made this September on the alpha build of the game. 

 [b][u]ALPHA Update Patch Notes | September 2025  

[/u][/b]This update brings broad polish across visuals, audio, gameplay, quality-of-life improvements, and key fixes. It’s not perfect yet, but we’re happy with the progress and excited about what’s ahead.

As for multiplayer, it's still internal only for now while we continue refining and fixing!
[/p][h3] 🎯 [u]Missions & Objectives[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Objective 2.0 (WIP):[/b] Overload, Destroy, and Steal are rebuilt with new art, interactions, and tighter world integration. Rescue and Kill also received less-obvious improvements. Ongoing effort.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mission rules:[/b] self-revive from incapacitation, limited lives, proper fail state, and a post-mission stats screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map rotation:[/b] weighted random selection to surface fresher content while keeping variety.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resistance layout:[/b] mission board flows easier → harder (A: Res 1, B: Res 2–3, C: Res 4, D: Res 5–6) to guide newer players.[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🤖 [u]AI, Spawning, Companions[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Spawning rework:[/b] validates path length to players, prefers flanking lanes some of the time, handles verticality better, and avoids already-cleared paths to keep pressure relevant without raising counts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-relevancy:[/b] far-behind enemies can safely “respawn” near active play to maintain pacing and performance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Companion overhaul:[/b] calmer movement, better firing positions, less idle noise when threat-free, and reworked auto-respawn if they drift too far.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Suppression changes:[/b] companion AI utilize less indirect fire as to not excessively add chaos, and how enemies react to player suppressive fire was tuned to be more reactive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drone deployable[/b] shows correct friend/foe tint when placed by enemies.[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🔫 [u]Weapons & Gear[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Weapon color selection[/b] added with tuned color sets. More refinement coming.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magazine ammo counters[/b] now functional on supported weapons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Railgun:[/b] new holo-sight for precision; damage aligned with the new health model.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Machine Gun & Beam Rifle:[/b] new WIP models in-game for iteration (not textured yet).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Materialize effect[/b] when grabbing weapons or items for a crisper handoff.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Railgun[/b] damage application corrected to match the new health model.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️ [u]Core Systems[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Character damage rework:[/b] simplified layered model (shield, armor, flesh) replaces limb-based health for clearer time-to-kill and easier balancing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drone handling:[/b] flight behavior tightened.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavy unit:[/b] hitbox corrected to eliminate ghost shots.[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🎨 [u]Levels & Art[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]ShipAlpha:[/b] extensive layout growth with new side areas and flow fixes. Some new combat spaces will be used more as objectives expand.[/p][/*][*][p][b]LD02:[/b] targeted level-art improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lobby:[/b] UV and widget proxy fixes, signage tweaks, and a lighting pass to unify the palette.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Respawn pod:[/b] upgraded art for clarity and cohesion.[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🧑‍🎨 [u]Characters & World[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Civilians:[/b] visual updates and masked variants to ease uncanny valley; further texture iteration queued.[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🎧[u]Audio & Music[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Combat mix pass:[/b] clearer threat readability in firefights; safeguards to reduce rare shot cutouts; trimmed flybys and impacts; distance scaling reduces companion dominance; camera-shake tuned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Score & radio:[/b] curated mission music and lobby tracks; radio volume behavior cleaned up.[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🧰 [u]Options & UX[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Abort Mission[/b] and [b]Quit Game[/b] added to Options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smooth-turn slider[/b] range recalibrated; slider audio fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hand smoothing toggle[/b] now applies correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet-time[/b] defaults to disabled, but can be enabled in Debug, and had its time dilation adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Locator[/b] destination reliability improved.[/p][/*][/list][h3] 🖥️ [u]PCVR Presentation[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Independent color-space calibration[/b] for the game view and spectator camera for better visuals in headset while enabling high quality footage capture.[/p][/*][/list][h3]👾 [u]Tweaks[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Player grab sphere[/b] reduced to ease foregrip and charging-handle conflicts.

[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for checking out today's devlog. Don’t forget to wishlist [b]Exoshock[/b] so you won’t miss any future updates!
‎   [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549390/EXOSHOCK/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 👨🏻‍💻 Polarity One: The Faces and Philosophy Behind Exoshock
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558627/59674643b0b5c7a8155e3638f71ab17654d27335.png"][/img]Welcome to our first development post, where will be discussing about the enthusiastic developers behind the upcoming cooperative sci-fi PvE ⚡[b]EXOSHOCK[/b]. 
[/p][h2][u][b]Meet the Team[/b][/u][/h2][p]
👨🏻‍💻 [b]Nicholas Bechen – Principal Gameplay Technical Artist[/b]

Nicholas is a relentless innovator who bridges the worlds of technical precision and artistic creativity. Since the 2012 Oculus Kickstarter ignited his passion for virtual reality, Nicholas has dedicated himself to mastering the medium, driven by a vision to create experiences that feel both visceral and authentic.

As Polarity One’s Principal Gameplay Technical Artist, Nicholas is the engine behind Exoshock’s intricate mechanics, fluid workflows, and immersive visuals. His approach to game development borders on obsessive, meticulously iterating every aspect of gameplay to ensure it meets his uncompromising standards. Whether it’s refining the snap of a reload or perfecting the atmospheric effects that pull players into the game world, Nicholas’s work guarantees Exoshock delivers on its promise of intuitive, rewarding gameplay.

Nicholas’s journey began with crafting Starcraft maps as a child, later evolving into music composition and solo game development. This foundation of creativity and technical curiosity now fuels his ability to innovate across disciplines. He’s not just building gameplay mechanics; he’s crafting moments of adrenaline and tension that connect deeply with players, ensuring every firefight, reload, and tactical decision feels exhilarating.

When he’s not immersed in VR development, Nicholas finds inspiration in the visceral thrill and immersion of motorcycle rides and the serene beauty of Colorado’s outdoors. His drive to push boundaries, both professionally and personally, embodies the spirit of Polarity One: bold, passionate, and player-focused.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558627/85c1bf70007ff3236b5874550ac5e389d4ae7bf3.png"][/img]
👨🏻‍💻 [b]Michael Shephard – Art Director[/b]

Michael is a visionary whose artistic sensibilities breathe life into Exoshock’s world, crafting a universe that is as immersive as it is groundbreaking. With a career spanning multiple disciplines, from 3D modeling and texturing to lighting and animation, Michael’s expertise ensures every corner of Exoshock feels cohesive, authentic, and dripping with style.

Michael approaches world-building with the eye of a filmmaker, drawing inspiration from directors like Ridley Scott and Terry Gilliam. This cinematic mindset enables him to subvert traditional gaming tropes, weaving in elements from diverse media to create a universe that feels both fresh and resonant. Every design decision, from the glow of ambient holograms to the gritty textures of a starship’s hull, reflects his commitment to immersion and narrative depth.

Passionate about philosophical ideas and sculpting, Michael’s creativity knows no bounds. His ability to blend aesthetics with functionality ensures that Exoshock isn’t just visually stunning but also mechanically engaging, with visuals that amplify the intensity and wonder of gameplay. His work turns the game’s environments into characters in their own right, inviting players to explore, strategize, and survive in a world teeming with danger and intrigue.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558627/057780531b6bd787cb661b7e5ba4ca6f14767dfa.png"][/img]
👨🏻‍💻 [b]Evan Federowicz – Lead Technical Architect[/b]

Evan is the linchpin of Exoshock’s multiplayer infrastructure, bringing a rare combination of technical mastery and hands-on experience to Polarity One. With a background in virtual reality development, 3D printing, and fabrication, Evan thrives on solving complex problems, building systems that are as scalable as they are innovative.

As the Lead Technical Architect, Evan’s work underpins every aspect of Exoshock’s multiplayer experience. From designing robust network replication systems to implementing seamless cross-platform integration, Evan ensures players can team up effortlessly and enjoy battles free from technical hiccups. His ability to anticipate challenges and deliver solutions allows the rest of the team to focus on their creative pursuits, knowing the game’s foundation is rock-solid.

Evan’s passion for gaming fuels his approach to development, combining a player-first mindset with a deep understanding of best practices. He’s not just building systems; he’s creating opportunities for unforgettable moments, whether it’s a last-second save by a teammate or the smooth execution of a squad strategy.

Though often behind the scenes, Evan’s work is the unsung hero of Exoshock, connecting players across platforms and ensuring every session is smooth, immersive, and endlessly replayable. His technical leadership is a testament to Polarity One’s commitment to innovation and quality.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558627/82d1d33ea4fae1da7ac5ec1e0f23a0685ede1d27.png"][/img]
💛 Thank you for reading about our Meet the Team community post. Stay tuned for more information that will dive into the technical aspects of [b]EXOSHOCK[/b], as well as updates on the game's progress.

For more information, don't hesitate to join our [url="https://discord.gg/ygC6seu4Yc"][b]Discord[/b][/url] server and especially wishlist the game on Steam!
